data.title: Income Tax Assessment 2024 (Einkommensteuerbescheid)
data.summary: Finanzamt Musterpotsdam issued the income tax assessment (Einkommensteuerbescheid) for 2024, now including rental income from Havelufer 14 in addition to salary. After offsetting withheld wage tax, €1,238.00 remains to be paid by 22 July 2025.
data.explanation: This is your official income tax assessment (Einkommensteuerbescheid) for 2024 from Finanzamt Musterpotsdam. It includes your salary and, for the first time, rental income from Havelufer 14. After deducting the wage tax already withheld, you still owe €1,238.00, which must be credited to the stated account by 22 July 2025. If you believe the assessment is incorrect, you may file an objection (Einspruch) with the Finanzamt; the app shows the deadline for this based on when the letter is deemed delivered. If you do nothing, the assessment becomes final and the amount remains payable regardless. Keep this notice, as it documents your 2024 income and deductions for your records.

key_facts.quote: Bitte überweisen Sie den Betrag von 1.238,00 € so, dass er spätestens am 22.07.2025 auf unserem Konto gutgeschrieben ist (Brandenburgische Musterkasse, IBAN DE49 1605 0000 0002 8700 00).
